label: R18-FP-PRESCAN-CUT
title: Split the round-pack leading-one scan from tiny classification
scope: Split round_pack_pre so the 256-bit leading-one/zero scan and derived exponent metadata are registered before normalization/tiny classification reaches pack_pre. Keep raw IEEE result, FPCR mode, NaN/signed-zero/FPSR behavior and single-outstanding held-response semantics. Precisely document ordinary/DIV/SQRT latency changes and preserve kill/reset/pause/reissue priority.
writes: focused scalar FP SV tests only
validation: P7-1/P7-3/P7-4/P7-5 raw-bit SV/Cocotb and strict lockstep after integration
latency table updated for all affected ordinary and DIV/SQRT paths
acceptance: No direct pp_pre.sig-to-pack_pre.is_tiny leading-one scan remains in one register-to-register cone; results and flags remain bit-exact; transaction and latency behavior is explicitly tested. Physical improvement is not claimed until new post-fit directional STA.
resource: Owner may edit and run only lightweight/static checks initially. Heavy Verilator/QEMU is serialized by the integrator; CPU<=50%, MemoryMax=16G, MemorySwapMax=0, VERILATOR_JOBS=1.
board_policy: No Quartus assembler, bitstream, JTAG, programming, power-on or board test without explicit user permission.
